$comment: TEMPLATE bug spec — App/FE (FRONTEND) defect → write from the USER's perspective: preconditions = install build + log in; steps = the UI journey (navigate / tap / swipe / open); actual/expected = what the user SEES. ONE spec feeds both outputs: redmine-bug.mjs → the board ticket (Textile), and bug-row.mjs → the Sheet row / candidate. Copy, fill, remove placeholders. Keep it developer-facing: short facts, no QA-internal taxonomy (severity/priority/invariant/tags live in the QA record, not the ticket body).
subject: The Notifications screen shows hardcoded mock data instead of real user notifications
preconditions: Login to any account or create new account
steps: Tap the bell icon in the top-right corner
Check the content of the Notifications (Updates) screen
actual: The "Notifications" screen renders hardcoded mock data that does not change regardless of the account's real activity.
expected: The screen shows the user's real notifications, or an empty state when there are none.
notes: Reproduced on iOS (<device> simulator, dev flavor).
On Android the screen could not be auto-verified: the bell icon has no accessibility id (suggestion for devs — add one; it also unblocks UI automation).
